summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the 100% offline Expo Notes app on web preview. All critical flows verified working: home screen with empty state, top bar (logo/checklist-shortcut/settings/search/sort), filter chips (All/Favorites/Pinned/Archived/Trash/Folders/Labels), FAB with 5 create options (text, checklist, voice, image, drawing — NO video ✓), text note create+autosave, checklist create/toggle/add-item, note colors (9 colors incl. clear), pin+favorite toggles, search with 'No notes found', sort sheet (6 options), archive via editor 3-dot menu (toast shown), delete-to-trash with confirm dialog, empty-trash button, folders CRUD, labels CRUD, folder/label assignment from editor (opt-folder / opt-labels), settings screen with theme light/dark/system (dark mode fully applied to home/editor/settings), all switches (layout/previews/completed/biometric), backup/restore rows, export-all txt/md/pdf, storage stats + clear cache, drawing note (canvas draws on mouse, save attaches thumb), voice note sheet opens with mic UI. No red-screen errors. No video option exists anywhere. No deprecated Expo packages detected (uses expo-audio, not expo-av).

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844 viewport, add-label-button rendered outside the visible bottom sheet area (below viewport) causing tap failure without scroll. Sheet content should be scrollable OR button pinned. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LabelPickerSheet.tsx

After tapping opt-archive the editor screen remains open (only a 'Note archived' toast appears). User must manually press back. Consider auto-navigating back to home on archive for consistency with delete-flow UX.

integration_issues.issue: After entering new folder name in new-folder-input and tapping add-folder-button, no folder-opt-* rows are rendered in the same sheet session — the folder appears to be created but the picker list does not refresh/re-render immediately. User has to reopen the sheet to see and select it.

issues: Console warning: 'format-color-reset' is not a valid material-community icon name (color-sheet uses it for the reset/none color) — icon renders as fallback. Choose a valid mdi icon such as 'format-color-marker-cancel' or 'close-circle-outline'.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — React Native Web is deprecating shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius. Migrate elevation/shadow styles to the new boxShadow prop for web compatibility.

action_items: Make the label picker bottom sheet content scrollable (or pin add-label-button) so it is reachable on 390x844 viewports.
Refresh the folder picker list after inline folder creation so the newly added folder appears and can be selected without reopening the sheet.
Replace the invalid 'format-color-reset' MaterialCommunityIcons name (see color picker) with a valid icon such as 'close-circle-outline'.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional UX) Auto-navigate back to Home after tapping opt-archive in the editor 3-dot menu.
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx is large but well-structured; consider splitting checklist and attachment sub-views into separate components as it grows.
All testIDs are consistently applied on interactive elements — great for automated testing.
Web data layer (repo.web.ts) correctly aliased by Metro; no expo-sqlite web-worker crash observed on preview.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed created — each browser session starts empty as designed (AsyncStorage web layer).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% offline; use web preview at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Data persists per-browser via AsyncStorage. When testing bottom sheets on 390x844, be aware some sheets may need vertical scroll to reach primary CTA (see LabelPickerSheet). Voice recording, camera, native PDF sharing are environment-limited on web and should not be treated as bugs.
